# frozen_string_literal: true
require '/home/petert/llm_eval/experiment/tools/validation_audit/native_full_array_validation'
evidence = '/home/petert/llm_para_campaigns/20261103-validation-strengthening'
workspace = '/tmp/validation-strengthening-20261103.aXM3pL'
completion = ValidationAudit.read(File.join(evidence, 'full-array-full/completion.json'))
raise 'Retrospective sweep is not complete' unless completion.fetch('status') == 'complete'
destination = File.join(evidence, 'native-full-array-smoke')
raise 'Smoke receipt already exists' if File.exist?(File.join(destination, 'completion.json'))
ids = %w[matmul_gpt-6.1-sol-medium_omp_r1 matmul_gpt-5.6-sol-low_mpi_r1]
reference = ValidationAudit.read(File.join(evidence, 'bindings/reference_matmul.json'))
session = ValidationAudit::NativeFullArray::Session.new
records = []
started = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
begin
  ValidationAudit::Runner.new(workspace: workspace, evidence: evidence).with_host do
    ids.each do |id|
      binding = ValidationAudit.read(File.join(evidence, 'bindings', id + '.json'))
      backend = id.split('_')[-2]
      output = File.join(destination, id)
      value = session.check(id: id, benchmark: 'matmul', backend: backend,
        executable: binding.fetch('executable'), source_root: File.join(binding.fetch('reused_cache').fetch('directory'), 'source'),
        reference_executable: reference.fetch('executable'),
        reference_source_root: File.join(reference.fetch('reused_cache').fetch('directory'), 'source'), output_dir: output)
      raise 'Control unexpectedly failed' unless value.fetch('passed')
      exported = ValidationAudit::NativeFullArray.export_files(output, value, benchmark: 'matmul', id: id, passed: true)
      raise 'Unexpected retained smoke evidence' unless exported.map(&:last) == %w[actual.json comparison.json receipt.json reference.json]
      records << value.merge('id' => id, 'source_binding_sha256' => ValidationAudit.sha(File.join(evidence, 'bindings', id + '.json')))
    end
  end
ensure
  session.close
end
raise 'Successful native temporary workspace was not cleaned up' if File.exist?(session.workspace)
result = { 'status' => 'complete', 'checks' => records, 'sequential_reference_executions' => 1,
  'unchanged_program_control_executions' => 2, 'benchmark_runs' => 0, 'llm_invocations' => 0,
  'elapsed_seconds' => Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - started,
  'script' => File.read(__FILE__), 'script_sha256' => ValidationAudit.sha(__FILE__), 'completed_at' => Time.now.utc.iso8601 }
ValidationAudit.save(File.join(destination, 'completion.json'), result)
puts JSON.pretty_generate(result.reject { |key, _| key == 'script' })
